lines: The battle between us and the weirdly-behaving Maika had begun.
Me
Stop it, Maika!! Don't you know who we are!?
Maika
Who gives a damn who ya are!! For now, just dieeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!!
*Boom!! Booooooom!!*
Maika was shooting at us wildly with the weapon in her handーthe Death Bazooka.
Me
Ugh!? Watch out, you two!!
Me
Scatter!! She'll get us if we stick together!!
Hebiko
Y-Yeah!!
Shikanosuke
G-Got it!!
While evading the explosive shells that were fired one after another from the Death Bazooka, I handed down orders to Hebiko and Shikanosuke.
Maika and I had been on the same team before during the practical exam.
At that time, fortunately, I had been able to grasp Maika's battle tendencies to some extentー
If I hadn't, all three of us definitely would have been vaporized in an instant.
Maika
Hey, you guys!! Stop runnin' around, it's annoyin'!! Just get burnt to a crisp already!!
Me
Shut up!! As if we'd let that happen!!
*Boom!! Booooooom!!*
While loud explosions thundered through the back alley, Maika's attacks continued.

And thenー
as Fürst watched that battle playing out, he called out in a cheerful voice.
Fürst
Oh-ho. It's just as she said, Fuma-kun. No useful data will be collected if you just keep running around.
Me
ーFürst!! What did you do to Maika!?
Maika had said that she "doesn't give a damn who we are" and was unleashing relentless attacks with the intent to kill.
It seemed that anything about us had completely disappeared from her brain.
Fürst
There's no need for me to answer that, right? Because you're all going to get killed by her right here anywayー
Me
Damn it... you perverted geezer...!!
However... even while tut-tutting, I was analyzing the situation in my head, trying to get to the bottom of it.
In the information we had just gathered about the missing persons, there was something about them "returning with completely different personalities."
That was exactly what was happening with Maika right now.
Maybe if Fürst was conducting some kind of brainwashing experiment, and if the missing persons were the victims of his experiment...
Fürst
Oh-ho-ho...
Me
(Perhaps that'sー!?)
Something in Fürst's hand that looked like an input terminal had caught my eye.
And Fürst was enthusiastically operating it while observing the fight between us and Maika.
Me
Hebiko!! Shikanosuke!! Target Fürst!! That device he has in his hand!!
I reached my judgment in an instant and gave them their orders.
Even three against one, it would be hard to win against Maika, and we couldn't afford to hurt her in the first place.
So to start with, we would attack Fürst, who was possibly the one controlling Maikaー
Hebiko
Got it, Fuma-chan!!
Shikanosuke
If this fails then you take the blaaaaame!!
While they each confirmed my orders, Hebiko and Shikanosuke dashed toward Fürst.
However, Fürst wasn't going to just stand there silently and suffer their attacks.
Fürst

Uh-oh, can't have that nowー
Protect me, Maika.

He operated the device in his hand at the same time as he gave the ordersー
and Maika moved in response.
Maika
Ughhh!? ...W-Wait, you shits!! I'm your opponent!!
Hebiko
!? Maika-chan!?
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeee!? Kamimura-san, forgive meeeeeee!!
Maika immediately aimed her Death Bazooka at the two of them and tried to block their way.

Howeverー
that was just as I had calculated.
Me
Sorry, Maika. Go take a short nap.
*Bash!!*
Maika
Ungh!?
Maika collapsed with a thud.
If she were to follow a sudden order, inevitably there was going to be an opening in her movement.
I aimed for that opening. I approached her from behind, and hit her hard on the back of the head.
Hebiko
Fuma-chan!!
Shikanosuke
You did it!! Good job, Fuma!!
Fürst
Well, I'll be!! So that's what you were aiming forー
Me
Tough luck, you geezer. With that, there's nobody left to protect you.
Without Maika's interference, there was nothing to be afraid of.
We surrounded the slightly panicked Fürst, but...
Fürst
Oh-ho... this isn't over yet, you know?
Me
What...?
Even while being surrounded by us, Fürst was smiling boldlyー
Fürst
The experiment this time is about unleashing the hidden potential of a human being through brainwashing.
Fürst
Well then, let's have her show her true powerー
With that, he entered something into the terminal he was holding. And thenー
Maika
Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuggghhh!!
Me
ーMaika!?
Maika, who I thought had been unconscious, suddenly started groaning.
A tremendous amount of incendiary energy was released from her entire body.

The intensely grimacing Maika slowly stood upー
and aimed her Death Bazooka at us.
Maika
Damn it... ya bastard...!! How dare ya do that to me...?!
Me
Oh shit!! Do whatever you can to evade her, you two!!!
I shouted to Hebiko and Shikanosuke.
You could tell from looking at the incendiary energy enveloping Maika's body.

"An experiment to unleash someone's hidden potential"ー
now that she had unleashed it, Maika's danger level was worlds apart from before.
Fürst
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!! Finish them, Maika!!
Fürst
Fürst let out a booming, triumphant laugh.
And the next momentー
Maika
Shuuuut uuuuup, ya damn geezer!! You're the one who's gonna buuuuuuuuuuuuuurn!!!
Fürst
Oh-ho...?
To our amazement, the one Maika was aiming her Death Bazooka atー
Was her supposed "master," Fürst, who was standing beyond us.
Maika

ーEat this!!!
Full power ≪G尺ヨN凡Dヨ≫!!!
*Boooooooooooooooooom!!!*
An explosion so big that everything went bright for a momentー
And in the place where Fürst had been standing, a spectacular pillar of flame was rising up.
Me
Maika!? You... but why!?
Maika had been brainwashed and should have been out of her mind. But despite that, whyー?
Maika
Oh, it's Fuma... So it was you that gave me a whack before? That was kinda refreshin'...
Maika replied with a frown, maybe because her head was still hurting from when I had hit her.
Maika
After that... I somehow suddenly felt a surge of power. Not really sure why though...
Me
A surge of power...?
Maika was repeatedly tilting her head. It seemed like she herself didn't know how she had come back to her senses either.
Fürst
Oh-ho-ho, I see... It seems that the impact to your head and the release of your hidden potential have invigorated your mind as well.
Fürst
I never thought something like this might happen... I was able to obtain quite an interesting experimental result.
Suddenly, a rasping chuckle could be heard from beyond the flames and smoke.
Me
Fürst!!?
Maika
You're still alive, ya bastard?!
We vigorously barged ahead and pushed through the blaze and fumes. Howeverー
Maika
Tch... Looks like he got away...
Fürst was no longer there, and only a few swirls of miasma were left behind, most likely from where he had disappeared through a gate of darkness.
Me
Sheesh. But case closed for the time being, I guess?
Fürst, the cause of the incident, had escaped, but we had found the missing Maika and brought her back to her senses.
On the whole, it should be fine to call it mission accomplished.
Shikanosuke
Pheeew~ That was scary... But I'm glad to see you back in your right mind, Kamimura-san.
Maika
Yeah, I've caused ya quite a bit of trouble. Seriously, I owe ya one, so thanks.
Shikanosuke
Uwhaaa!? N-No, I mean we just did what all friends would do... eheh, ehehehe...
Being thanked by Maika, whom he adored, Shikanosuke was absolutely elated.
Me
Well, we were about to be turned into cinders quite a few times though...
Maika
Hehe, I told ya I'm sorry. I'll treat ya to somethin' later, so gimme a break.
Maika put on a fearless grin.
The shock of awakening from the brainwashing seemed to have worn off, and she was almost completely back to her normal self.
Hebiko
But still, this Fürst guy really is unforgivable!
Maika
Yeah, totally!! If I see that geezer again, I'll definitely kick his ass!
Hebiko
Uh huh. Maika-chan, you were in a harrowing situation too, huh. He must've used some super dirty trick to catch you, right?
When Hebiko asked, for some reason Maika became visibly distraught.
Maika
Eh!? Y-Yeah, you're right...!! He set a really dirty trap to catch me, ahaha...
Me
Hm? Why are you so flustered?
Maika
S-Stop being stupid!! Why would I be flustered...!?
Me
Hmmm...? Actually, I had also been wondering about that.
Me
He's an executive of Nomad, but how did someone as stupidly powerful as you get caught...?
Maika
M-More importantly, I almost forgot!! My family must've been worried, so let's get home already!!
Maika said and quickly walked towards the station.
Me
...Oh well, let's head home too.
Hebiko
You're right. Good work today as well, guys♪
I hadn't been able to hear the reason for Maika getting captured, but she was back safe and sound, and I guess that was all that mattered.
And so the three of us followed Maika and walked toward the station.
Maika
(Ugh, damn it...!! There's no way I can tell them...)
Maika
(How I was lured by that geezer with a first-hand course on how to do stylish gyaru makeup...!!)
